spacecraft.name: Voyager 1
facts: Launched 5 September 1977, slightly after Voyager 2.
Flew past Jupiter (1979) and Saturn (1980), then headed north of the ecliptic.
Crossed the heliopause in 2012 — the first human-made object in interstellar space.

spacecraft.name: Voyager 2
facts: The only spacecraft to visit Uranus (1986) and Neptune (1989).
Used a rare planetary alignment for the Grand Tour trajectory.
Entered interstellar space in 2018.

spacecraft.name: Pioneer 10
facts: First spacecraft to fly through the asteroid belt and visit Jupiter (1973).
Carries the Pioneer plaque — a message for any extraterrestrial finders.
Last contact 23 January 2003.

spacecraft.name: Pioneer 11
facts: First spacecraft to visit Saturn (1979).
Used Jupiter for a gravity assist toward Saturn.
Last transmission September 1995.

spacecraft.name: New Horizons
facts: Fastest spacecraft ever launched from Earth at the time (16.26 km/s).
Flew past Pluto on 14 July 2015 — first close-up of the dwarf planet.
Visited Kuiper belt object Arrokoth (Ultima Thule) on 1 January 2019.

spacecraft.name: Parker Solar Probe
facts: The fastest human-made object — over 690,000 km/h at perihelion.
Repeated Venus gravity assists shrink its highly eccentric orbit.
First spacecraft to fly through the Sun's corona.

spacecraft.name: Juno
facts: Arrived at Jupiter on 5 July 2016 after an Earth gravity assist.
Polar orbit designed to map Jupiter's gravity, magnetic field, and atmosphere.
Named after the Roman goddess, wife of Jupiter.

spacecraft.name: Cassini
facts: Orbited Saturn from 2004 to 2017 with the Huygens Titan lander.
Discovered geysers on Enceladus and seas of methane on Titan.
Ended with a controlled plunge into Saturn on 15 September 2017.
